messages:
Marie Nguyen: Hi team — starting the activation/handoff thread for Phaedra Health. High-level goals: production API integration, SSO + audit logs, and a smooth ramp to their target QPS (initially ~5 qps). Primary success criteria listed below.

Ajay Patel: Who is the technical lead on their side? Need an API contact and infra owner. cc @Sophie Li for customer PM details.

Sophie Li: Customer tech lead is Jamal Khan (Phaedra infra). Serena is their PM. I’ll DM Jamal and loop him into this thread.

Paul Torres: On our side I’ll own the platform scoping, perf baseline, and canary plan. Plan: set up staging cluster, run smoke tests, then a perf canary in week 2.

Marie Nguyen: Draft success criteria (for internal alignment):
- Integration: end-to-end prod request from their app (1+ live call)
- Reliability: p95 latency under 200ms for normal user traffic by week 3
- Observability: dashboards + cost alerts enabled
- Security: SSO + audit log forwarding verified
- Enablement: 2 training sessions (dev & ops) completed

onboarding-bot: Zoom invite created for 2034-03-05 16:00 UTC — https://zoom.us/j/123456789 (auto-created by onboarding-bot)

Ajay Patel: Noted risks: if we miss p95 SLO by week 3, flag as renewal-risk. Volume ramp and latency are the strongest signals for renewal. Recommend a short Dedicated trial if perf tuning is needed.

Sophie Li: Proposed timeline: Week 0: creds & provisioning; Week 1: staging integration + smoke tests; Week 2: perf canary & tuning; Week 3: prod cutover; Week 4: training + handoff. I’ll create calendar blocks.

Paul Torres: Action on ops: I’ll produce the runbook + Grafana dashboard (ETA EOD Friday). Will include sample queries for token spend and p95 latency.

Marie Nguyen: Enablement plan: developer SDK walkthrough (Ajay), ops runbook + dashboard review (Paul), and a product training (Sophie). Need owners for slides and recording.

Ajay Patel: I can own the SDK walkthrough slides and sample app. Will add a checklist for integration tests and rate-limit expectations.

Sophie Li: Creating a shared Confluence page now: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/CS/Phaedra-Activation (will add runbook, invites, and meeting notes).

Marie Nguyen: Feedback capture: we’ll use the Confluence comments + a weekly sentiment check (quick 5-question pulse with Serena). Anything marked as blocking ramp gets a 'renewal-risk' tag.

Paul Torres: For performance troubleshooting, I'll enable continuous request logging for the canary window and attach flamegraphs if we see tail latency.

Sophie Li: Customer update — Jamal confirmed he can share initial traffic by tomorrow and Serena wants an overview for execs week 3.

Marie Nguyen: Summary / immediate action items: 1) Sophie: invite/calendar + Confluence page; 2) Paul: runbook + dashboard by EOD Fri; 3) Ajay: SDK checklist + sample app; 4) Marie: weekly 30m sync w/ customer (I'll send recurring invite). Please confirm ownership here.

Ajay Patel: Confirmed, I’ll do the SDK work.

Paul Torres: Confirmed on runbook/dashboard.

Sophie Li: Confirmed — invites + Confluence page sent.

Marie Nguyen: Great — closing the loop. We’ll treat any perf or security blocking issues as high priority (add 'renewal-risk' label). Thanks team :thumbsup:
